title: fix(plugin-grid): derive the bulk executor data-source face from DataSource and stop erasing the check at the hand-off
body:
Fixes #9722

`BulkExecutorOptions.dataSource` RESTATED the members it consumes instead of deriving them, and
the restatement had rotted: it still spelled the pre-objectui#9511 union — read it as
"ReadonlyArray of string-or-number" (angle brackets are spelled out in this body on purpose;
GitHub's body sanitizer eats tag-shaped fragments, including inside backticks) — for
`bulkUpdate` / `bulkDelete`, after `DataSource` narrowed both doors to plain strings. Both
members are declared with **property syntax**, so `strictFunctionTypes` compares their
parameters **contravariantly**: the real `DataSource` was therefore **not assignable to that
face at all**. The one in-tree hand-off compiled only because it cast to `any`.

⇒ objectui#9712's reading that narrowing those doors costs **zero call sites** was true **BY
THAT CAST**, not because the consumer agreed.

**Clause-②: yes (widening)** — declared conservatively, and handed to the contract-review seat
rather than settled here (see "What moves, and for whom" below).

---

## ⭐ What each cast was paying for — established BEFORE anything was repaired

The card marked this NOT MEASURED and named it as the whole risk: deleting a cast to make one
claim true, while silently erasing a different check, would be this defect committed a second
time. So each cast was removed **on its own**, with the mutation proven on disk (blob hash
against the HEAD blob, byte delta, anchor count) and restored under a `trap`, before any result
was read. **They needed different answers.**

### Cast 1 — the `RecordDetailPanel` hand-off: paying for NOTHING

    PRE  anchor count 2 ; bytes 296938 ; blob faa5a1b8…
    POST anchor count 1 ; bytes 296931 ; blob f406dade… ; BYTE_DELTA=-7
    TYPECHECK_EXIT=0        (zero errors)
    RESTORE_BLOB_EQUAL=yes ; GIT_DIFF_HEAD_BYTES=0

Both sides already declare the **same** `DataSource | undefined` from `@object-ui/types` — the
grid's own prop type and `RecordDetailPanelProps.dataSource` are the same import. ⚠️ Note this
site is **not** a bulk-door hand-off at all: it hands the value to `RecordDetailPanel`, not to
`BulkActionDialog`. That correction to the card's table is the only thing on it that did not
survive re-derivation; everything else did.

**A zero needs a lit control on the same instrument at the same address.** Instrument DOMAIN:
`tsc --noEmit` over `packages/plugin-grid` plus `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. PREDICATE: JSX prop
assignability. Control — with the cast gone, the prop value at that address was mutated to a
`string`:

    MUTATOR: line 4728 now 'dataSource={dataSource as unknown as string}'
    POST blob 325e581b… ; BYTE_DELTA=21
    TYPECHECK_EXIT=2
    src/ObjectGrid.tsx(4728,13): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'DataSource of any'.
    RESTORE_BLOB_EQUAL=yes ; GIT_DIFF_HEAD=empty

⇒ the instrument reports **at that exact address**, so the zero above is an absence, not a blind
spot. Cast removed outright.

### Cast 2 — the `BulkActionDialog` hand-off: paying for TWO separate things

Removing it outright reddens, and the **first** error tsc prints is not the card's finding:

    src/ObjectGrid.tsx(5328,7): error TS2322: Type 'DataSource of any, or undefined' is not assignable to …
      Type 'undefined' is not assignable to …

That is the **optional-vs-required arm** — this grid declares `dataSource?: DataSource`, the
dialog demands one. ⚠️ tsc stops at the first failing union member, so reading only this run
would have hidden the rest. A second run removed that factor with a non-null assertion alone:

    POST line 5328: dataSource={dataSource!} ; BYTE_DELTA=-6
    TYPECHECK_EXIT=2
    src/ObjectGrid.tsx(5328,7): error TS2322: Type 'DataSource of any' is not assignable to …
      Types of property 'bulkUpdate' are incompatible.
        … Types of parameters 'ids' and 'ids' are incompatible.
          Type 'readonly (string | number)[]' is not assignable to type 'readonly string[]'.

⇒ exactly the contravariance the card predicted, and it is the **second** thing the cast was
carrying, not the only one. The dialog's `find` / `findOne` intersection members turned out to
be innocent: they raise nothing once the bulk doors agree.

---

## The repair

1. **`useBulkExecutor`** — the two bulk doors are now the interface's own members,
   `DataSource['bulkUpdate']` / `DataSource['bulkDelete']`. A copy that merely agrees today can
   drift again; identity cannot.
2. **`update` / `delete` stay spelled out, deliberately.** `Pick`ing all four instead imports
   return types this executor never reads and so **NARROWS** what a consumer may inject —
   measured, not assumed: it reddened four in-tree doubles on `delete`'s "Promise of boolean"
   alone (`useBulkExecutor.test.ts` lines 100 / 236 / 254 / 279). A narrowing here would be the
   opposite arm of Clause-②, so the loose returns are kept.
3. **The `BulkActionDialog` hand-off is now `dataSource={dataSource!}`.** The non-null assertion
   erases exactly one thing — the optional arm — and preserves today's runtime behaviour
   exactly (a grid with no data source still hands the dialog `undefined`). Everything else at
   that site is checked again.
4. **The `RecordDetailPanel` hand-off takes the value plain.** The neighbouring `objectSchema`
   cast is a different question and is deliberately left alone.
5. **⛔ `DataSource` is not re-widened.** objectui#9511's ruling B is maintainer-adopted; this
   card is repaired on the consumer's side only.

## The new pin, and its full ablation

`packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts` — compile-time
identity rows plus a source-text census. ⚠️ **A count is invariant under quotation**: the prose
that retires each spelling also quotes it, so every census row reads a **scoped slice** (the
`dataSource` member block; one JSX opening tag), and a control row asserts that the files
themselves still contain both retired spellings while the slices do not.

Ablation — the restatement was put back (both doors re-spelled with the old union), mutation
proven on disk, restored under a `trap`:

    PRE  blob 9d18c09d… ; CONTROL: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json BEFORE the mutation = exit 0
    POST blob 1d01b3f0… ; BYTE_DELTA=176 ; 9 insertions, 2 deletions
    TYPETESTS_AFTER_EXIT=2
      src/ObjectGrid.tsx(5352,7): error TS2322        ← the hand-off is a real check again
      bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts(72,10): TS2344 'false' does not satisfy 'true'
      bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts(74,10): TS2344 'false' does not satisfy 'true'
      bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts(88,9):  TS2322 whole-adapter assignability
      bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts(94,3):  TS2578 Unused '@ts-expect-error'
      bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts(96,3):  TS2578 Unused '@ts-expect-error'
    vitest: Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9)   ← the two census rows, with their reasons
    RESTORE_BLOB_EQUAL=yes ; GIT_DIFF_HEAD=empty

Both `@ts-expect-error` controls going **unused** under the mutation is the point: each fires for
exactly the drift it guards, and the neighbouring string calls stay legal.

## What moves, and for whom

For an implementor the executor's face **relaxes**: a `bulkUpdate` accepting only strings used to
be refused and is now accepted; one accepting the old union was accepted before and still is.
Nothing narrows; no runtime behaviour changes.

Reachability of the moved face, measured on the built package (lit control / absent control on
the same instrument): `dist/index.d.ts` scores **0** for `BulkExecutorOptions`, `useBulkExecutor`
and `BulkActionDialog`, against **3** for `ObjectGridComponentProps` (lit) and **0** for a
nonsense token (absent). The type is shipped as bytes — `files` ships `dist` — but it is not
reachable from the package entry and the `exports` map declares no subpath wildcard. The
conservative arm is taken anyway, which is why this PR declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and a
`minor` changeset, and why the determination is handed to the seat rather than settled here.

In-tree consumers outside `packages/plugin-grid`: **none**. Every hit for `useBulkExecutor` /
`BulkActionDialog` elsewhere in `packages`, `apps`, `examples`, `e2e` is prose in a comment;
lit control, 17 files inside `plugin-grid`.

## Gates — exit code captured to a variable before any pipe, verdict line quoted

| gate | exit | reading |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` | 0 | `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/` (repo root, the CI-equivalent form) | 0 | `Test Files 134 passed (134)` · `Tests 1247 passed (1247)` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` | 0 | `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | "2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)" |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | "scanned 7825 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary" |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)` |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | report-only; 3 pending changesets name `ObjectGrid.tsx` — read, see below |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test …` | 0 | "NOT GOVERNED — 4 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s)" |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | 0 | the new census anchors on `import.meta.url`, never the cwd |
| `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` · `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 · 0 | OK |

The dispatch named `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`; in this repo the script is
at `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (the first spelling exits 1 with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`,
which is a wrong path, not a red gate).

`check:changeset-claims` asked me to read three pending changesets that name `ObjectGrid.tsx`
(`4730-retire-dead-locale-key-batch`, `6597-retire-fieldmeta-referenceto`,
`7762-object-grid-export-options-bare-array-refusal`). None is falsified: this diff moves two JSX
prop values and adds comments, and touches no locale key, no relational-meta pass-through and no
`exportOptions` reader.

**Declared narrowings.** `eslint` was run on the three changed files only (exit 0; 0 errors, 210
pre-existing warnings in `ObjectGrid.tsx`); the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run. The
`integration`-style browser tiers are likewise left to CI.
